text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV P1 — GPU pool eu-west-3/gpu-pool-3 resident memory 98%, queue length 420 (baseline ~30). Autoscaler attempts failed (max nodes reached). Triggering incident runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/autoscale

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Paging cloudops and ML. Handing off to @Raj for model-side investigation.

Raj: seeing a sudden rise in KV cache entries tied to model v17.x canary — context windows ballooning from ~4k to ~48k during prefill. Likely cause: tokenizer change + longer prompt glue.

Emily: confirmed. Canary rollout started ~2499989000, ~30% traffic. Memory per inference up ~3.8x on same seq len distribution due to kv retention.

David-ML: are we sure it's kv-cache and not a memory leak? pulling a few `pmap` traces now.

cloudops-bot: autoscaler note: reached quota limit for pool eu-west-3 (max_instances=24). Further scale attempts will be rejected.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) throttle canary traffic to 0% 2) force rollback of v17 canary 3) enable aggressive kv eviction / reduce max context on serving config. Which is fastest?

Raj: throttle canary first. We still need to confirm regressions (latency + token cost). Throttle command: `rictl traffic set --model redwood/v17 --pct 0 --env eu-west-3`

Emily: doing throttle now. `rictl traffic set --model redwood/v17 --pct 0 --env eu-west-3` — command accepted. Canary traffic -> 0% :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Action logged: traffic throttled for redwood/v17 in eu-west-3 by Emily (timestamp 2499991203).

Chloe-Support: support getting incoming customer tickets reporting "500 / inference timeout" and increased latency. Which tenants impacted? need list for comms.

Emily: pulling impacted customers from request logs. Query: `SELECT tenant_id, count(1) FROM requests WHERE env='eu-west-3' AND ts > 2499990000 GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 50;`

Emily: top-impacted: tenant-739, tenant-1203, tenant-ops-test. I'll DM support with IDs and rough ETA.

Maria-Product: we need a short incident blurb for customers. Keep it: "We experienced elevated latency and errors in eu-west-3 due to a model rollout increasing GPU memory usage; mitigation in progress." Chloe will post after we confirm rollback.

David-ML: here's a short diagnostic dump from a hot pod (sanitized):
```
# memory summary
GPU0 resident: 24.7GB / 25GB
kv_entries: 2.1M  # 5x baseline
avg_seq_len: 18600
prefill_tasks: 320
batch_size: 8
latency_95: 1.8s (was 0.4s)
```

Raj: that kv_entries number is the smoking gun. v17 changed the keying for prefix caching to store conversational anchors per segment causing duplication across prefill threads. Should revert keying or use pruning.

oncall-sre: two parallel actions now: A) keep traffic throttled (done), B) emergency rollback of canary to v16 in eu-west-3. I'll coordinate the rollback.

Emily: starting rollback: `rictl rollout cancel --model redwood/v17 --env eu-west-3 && rictl rollout promote --model redwood/v16 --env eu-west-3`

cloudops-bot: rollback job submitted (job id 6a3f7). Expected completion ~90s per shard.

incident-bot: NOTE — autoscaler will not downscale automatically while rollback is running; manual scale checks recommended.

Raj: while rollback is in flight, we should also push a serving config patch to reduce max_context and set kv-eviction=aggressive to prevent immediate re-surge if something else touches the pool: `rictl config set --model redwood/v16 --env eu-west-3 --kv-eviction aggressive --max-context 4096`

Emily: applied config patch to v16. Command returned 200.

cloudops-bot: rollback progress: 12/24 shards updated. Memory usage trending down on updated shards.

oncall-sre: keep an eye on queue length and QPS. If it drops under 60 and memory < 80% across shards we can de-escalate.

Chloe-Support: I've prepared a customer message draft and posted to #support-comms (waiting approval). Will tag impacted tenants after we confirm rollback success.

David-ML: post-mortem note: we need a canary guard that checks kv-entry growth heuristic (e.g., kv_entries / baseline > 2) and fails canary or scales to isolated pool. Filing an RFC.

Emily: rollback complete. cloudops-bot: 24/24 shards updated. Current resident GPU average 63%. queue length 28. Latency p95 back to 0.45s.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — P1 auto-alert closed 2499991505. Root cause: model v17 canary introduced KV keying change + longer prefill that multiplied kv-cache usage, autoscaler hit pool cap and could not recover.

Maria-Product: good job. Next steps: 1) block v17 until regression fixed 2) implement kv growth guard in rollout pipeline 3) update runbook with explicit autoscale-quota checks before canary.

Raj: also adding a temporary metric alert for kv_entries growth per pod > 2x baseline to trigger pre-canary abort.

Chloe-Support: sent customer notifications to impacted tenants with RCA ETA (postmortem to follow).

oncall-sre: final note — consider increasing reserve capacity or soft-limits per region for critical pools; will propose in follow-up. :thumbsup:

David-ML: creating postmortem ticket in JIRA: RED-OPS-4891. Assigning owners for rollback remediation and rollout gate.

cloudops-bot: incident timeline appended to incident log (id: 2026-IO-842).

Emily: closing thread here. If anything flares up ping oncall.

(End of thread)
